remarks: Move-In Ready! Stylish One-Bedroom Condo in Stamford's Sought-After Springdale Neighborhood Welcome to this well-maintained one-bedroom condo, perfectly located in Stamford's highly desirable Springdale area-right on the border of Darien and New Canaan. Offering the ideal balance of convenience and charm, this home is just steps from the train station, with shopping, dining, and everyday essentials right outside your door. Springdale delivers that rare "small town feel" while keeping you seamlessly connected to everything. Inside, you'll find gleaming hardwood floors throughout, creating a warm yet modern atmosphere. Low common charges that include heat and hot water make this an easy, cost-effective choice. Whether you're a first-time homeowner or an investor, this condo is a smart opportunity. Units in this prime location rent quickly thanks to proximity to the train, restaurants, and shops. Don't miss your chance to own in one of Stamford's most desirable neighborhoods-schedule a showing today!
